items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: Yes I know I knew of him I never met him yeah.

ctx.x: Oh do you remember anything about his clarinet? I know he gave one of them once when he sort of gave up he had trouble with his teeth he gave one to John Reed's wife you knew John Reed I
suppose had been connected. Yes I know I knew of him I never met him yeah. Remember that was 1943

I visited them in Cincinnati after he left victory went to Crosley during the war and shortly before that he'd become discouraged with the clarinet on account of his teeth or something and decided to give it up if I remember it was 1943 there. Yeah. And he gave her one of his old clarinets and then later he had his brother to fix up his teeth and some bridge work. Do you know anything about his teeth? Did you ever inspect them or did he ever talk about them? No. Did he show you anything? No. Never did no. They…
